title: 第10章 离心异梦
content_zh:
秦英豪想到当年力战大化三鬼的情景，嘴角上不自禁出现了一丝笑意，然而这是愁苦中的一丝微笑，是伤心中一闪即逝的欢欣。于是他想到腿伤愈后，与方玲结成夫妇，那个刻骨铭心、倾心相爱的妻子，就是眼前这个美妇。她在身前不过五尺，这五尺却比五千里、五万里的路程更加遥远。

    于是他想到两人新婚后那段欢乐的日子，他带着娇妻一同去拜祭闵恩仇、范知悦夫妇，见坟墓坏处修整好了，他把龙雀宝刀封在坟前地下土中，心想：“世上除了闵恩仇，再也没人配用这口宝刀。他既不在世上了，宝刀就该陪着他。要是他仍在世上，自己自会双手奉刀，送了给他，然后和他相对痛饮，尽醉方休。”

    在闵恩仇的墓前，他把当年这场比武与误伤的经过说给妻子听。他从来不爱多说话，这一天却是说得滔滔不绝。这件事在他心中郁积了十年，直到今天，才在最亲近的人面前发泄出来。他办了许多酒菜来祭奠闵恩仇，摆满了一桌，就像当年闵夫人在他们比武时做了一桌菜那样。

    于是他喝了不少酒，好像这位生平唯一的知己复活了，与他一起欢谈畅饮。他愈喝得多，愈说得多。说了如何用北斗刀法打败大化三鬼，从刀法说到对这位闵刀王的钦佩与崇仰，说到造化弄人，人世无常，说到闵夫人对丈夫的情爱，他说：“像这样的女人，要是丈夫在水里，她一定也在水里，丈夫在火里，她也在火里……”

    突然，看到妻子脸色变了，掩着脸远远奔开……他追上去想要解释，但他醉了，他不会说话，何况，他心中确是记得旅馆中三鬼火攻的那一幕……他是在火里，而她却独自先逃了出去……

    他一生慷慨豪侠，素来不理会小节，然而这是他生死以之相爱的人……在他脑子里，一直觉得方玲应该逃出去，她是女人，不会半点武功，见到了浓烟烈火自然害怕，她那时又不是他妻子，陪着他死了，又有什么好处？但在心里，他深深盼望在自己遇到危难时，有个心爱的人守在身旁，盼望心爱的人不要弃他而先逃……他一直羡慕闵恩仇有个真心相爱的夫人，自己可没有。闵恩仇虽然早死，这一生却比自己过得快活。

    酒醉后，在闵恩仇墓前无意中说错一句话，也可说是无意中流露了真心。这句话造成了夫妻间永难弥补的裂痕。虽然，秦英豪始终极深厚极诚挚地爱着妻子。

    他永远不再提到这件事，甚至连闵恩仇的名字也不提，方玲自然也不会提。

    后来女儿秦佳茵出生了，像母亲一般的美丽，像母亲一般的娇嫩，夫妻间的感情也加深了一层。然而，他是出身草莽的江湖豪杰，妻子却是位公家千金。他天性沉默寡言，整天板着脸，妻子却需要温柔体贴、低声下气的安慰。她要男人风雅斯文、懂得女人的小性儿，要男人会说笑、会调情……秦英豪空有一身打遍天下无敌手的武功，妻子所要的一切却全没有。如果方玲会武功，有一点江湖豪气，或许会佩服丈夫的本事，会懂得他为什么是当世一位顶天立地的奇男子。但她压根瞧不起武功，甚至从心底里厌憎武功。因为，她父亲是被武人害死的，起因是在于一把刀；又因为，她嫁了一个不理会自己心事的男人，起因竟是在于这男人用武功救了自己。

    她一生中曾有一段短短的时光，对武功感到了一点兴趣，那是丈夫的一个朋友来作客的时候，就是这个英俊潇洒的李丰粮。他没一句话不讨人欢喜，没一个眼色不是软绵绵的叫人想起了就会心跳。但奇怪得很，丈夫对这位李董却不大瞧得起，对他爱理不理的，招待客人的事就落在她身上。
content_en:
Yi Diandian said: "Yes, Zhu Jinya is my biological father. Although he caused such misfortune to our mother and daughter, my master said: 'How can a person be like this if he has no parents?' When I bid farewell to my master and came east, my master told me: 'Your father has done many evil things, and he will be in trouble in this life. If he is in trouble, you can save him three times, as a favor to your father.The love of a woman.From now on, you are you and he is him, it doesn’t matter any more.”My mother suffered such a tragedy in her life, all because of this person named Zhu. When I came to the Central Plains, the first thing I did was to go to Longxi to avenge my mother. One night, I went to Zhu’s house to investigate, and I saw Zhu Jinya ordering a large number of his men.The gold and silver were distributed to various departments in Viking, Hunan, and Guangdong, saying it was a tribute to the Mid-Autumn Festival.They also sent people to various provinces to deliver gifts. The recipients of the gifts were all famous martial arts tycoons in the world. It was expected that they were all people who shared his anger.They were either local tycoons from the fish and meat village, or they were bullies who oppressed the good people.A police officer met and said that Minister Wu invited him to participate in some Wu Kui conference, and his son Zhu Jiajun was also there. This Zhu Jiajun is my brother.I saw that his features and nose were very similar to mine, and then I looked back at Zhu Jinya and said, "Oh, God has not treated me well. My appearance is somewhat similar to that of this bully."

"I felt sour in my heart, and I let go of my hand that was holding the handle of the knife. Although this man has done all kinds of evil, he is my father after all, so I wanted to deny him, but I couldn't go against God's will. The next day, I saw you making a scene at Jin Mao Restaurant and Jin Mao Yin.Okay, let's ask someone to carry the gold and silver to the Jinmao Guild Hall for gambling. I followed the idlers to watch the excitement, and I was secretly amused.This old man's New Year friend is indeed a hero, but he is also really messing around..." He pursed his lips and smiled sweetly.

Min Jiageng asked: "Then why do you call Wang Wanhu brother uncle?" Yi Diandian did not answer him, but said: "Brother Min, you are brave and not afraid of rape. I really admire you. Zhu Jinya bullied Li Chunquan's family like this. My sister was also very angry. Even if it was not for my mother's grudge, thisI had to take action even if I encountered you.Later, when I saw you and the Zhu family fighting at Puji Temple, I wanted you to kill Zhu Jinya, but Zhu Jiajun was my brother and he didn't do any evil this time, but I wanted to beg you to spare his life.You forced Zhu Jinya to kill himself with a stick, so I threw the ring and saved his life.A little hooligan chased him away. I was so stupid that I followed him to watch the fun.When I realized that there was a scam and rushed back to Puji Temple, all three of the Li family had been killed by Zhu Jinya."Brother Min, I'm so sorry. If I had come back a moment earlier, I could have saved the three of the Li family. I regretted this for a long time. I felt so sad."I couldn't help but follow you all the way, wanting to catch up with you and make a good apology to you.Brother Min, I want to apologize to you. I have been thinking about it for a long time.Please forgive me for the little girl who has lost her parents since she was a child, has no tutor, and has done so many things!" With sincere words and a gentle look on his face, he stood up and bowed.Min Jiageng also stood up, bowed in return, and said, "I am reckless by nature, and I have offended many people in the past."

Yi Diandian continued: "But along the way, I stole your backpack, fought with you, and pushed you into the river. I had no intention of apologizing, just because my uncle said you were so good and praised you to the sky. He said that none of the young people today can be as good as you. I am also twenty years old."Man, I'm not convinced anymore.You are strong in martial arts, and you are kind and righteous, but...but..." Min Jiageng said, "But this little Min is careless and too confused.The two hooligans lured him away with just a few words.Didn't the three members of the Li family die under his stupid hands?He wanted to do good things, but he helped the bad guy send a message to Daxia Qin, which blinded him.Minister Wu sent someone to pick up his old sweetheart and his illegitimate son, but he had no reason to complain.There was a trap to be negotiated for Zhu Jinya, and he jumped into it without thinking.This Xiao Min is a reckless man, and even with martial arts, he can't beat a girl. If that girl really wanted to kill him that night in Qingguang Temple, wouldn't she have already killed him?"

Yi Diandian said: "That's not true. You showed mercy many times during the fight that night. You...you are so...you are so good!"

That night in the Qingguang Temple, Min Jiageng put his left arm around her waist, and Yi Diandian blurted out, "Let me go!" Min Jiageng immediately let go, and she praised him: "So good!" He mentioned it again now., Yu Sheng didn’t know the scene at that time, Min Jiageng couldn’t help but feel a great sweetness in his heart after listening to it. Seeing Yi Diandian’s cheeks slightly blushed, and even more connected, he slowly asked: "Next time I bump into ZhuJin Ya, are you going to save him?" Yi Diandian said, "I have saved him three times.The love between father and daughter is over. Every time I save him, I can't help but cry bitterly afterwards.I feel sorry for my father, but I feel sorry for my dead mother.No!Even if I can't kill him myself, I will never save him again!"

Yu Sheng asked: "Has your father passed away?" Yi Diandian said: "After my mother escaped from Longxi, she begged all the way north. She just wanted to leave Longxi as far as possible, never to see the Zhu family again, and never hear his name again. She lived on the road for a few months, and then came to Nanchang and joined a family named Kong to work as a maid..." Min Jiageng said: "The Kong family in Nanchang, Jiangxi, is related to the benevolent and righteous hero Kong Weixin?"

The muscles on Yi Dian's mouth moved slightly and he said: "My mother died in Kong... the home of the hero Renyi. Before my mother died, Wang Wanhu happened to pass by and took me to Abai. After more than 20 years, I returned to the Central Plains."Min Jiageng asked: "I don't know how to call my master?Your martial arts are omnipotent and masterful. Your master must be a rare person.Even the famous knight from Sheyang may not have such ability!"

Yi Diandian said: "My master's name has not been approved by her, so I cannot tell you for the time being. Please forgive me. As for the famous knight from Sheyang, we have also heard his name in Abai. At that time, Taoist Master Bozhen of the Xieli Society was very unconvinced and decided to come to Sheyang to compete with him. In the end,So I was stopped.That year, my uncle came to the Central Plains and met you. After he returned to Abai, he praised you very much.This time my little sister came to the east, and Aunt Yidan asked me to ride her flaming horse, saying that if I met this young hero named Min, I would give this flaming horse to me."

Min Jiageng asked curiously: "Who is this Aunt Yidan? She has never met me, so why did she give me such a big gift?"

Yi Dandian said: "Speaking of Aunt Yidan, she was famous in the world at that time. She was the wife of Director Lei of the Xieli Society, and people in the world called her Wang Yidan. She heard her old uncle talk about you destroying the Iron Hall in Wenjiabao, and also heard that you liked the flame horse very much. She complained to him at that time: 'Since there is such a person, why don't you just give this horse to him? Could it be that you, Director Wang, can make friends with young heroes, but I can't make friends with him?'"

After listening to this, Min Jiageng realized that Yi Diandian had left a note in the inn that day saying "the horse has returned to the rightful owner". It turned out to be for this reason. He was very grateful to Wang Yidan and thought to himself: "Such a BMW is hard to find. This aunt and I are thousands of miles apart, and we fell in love with each other just because of other people's words of praise."It's such a great gift that I, Min Jiageng, really can't repay you." He then asked, "I think I'll be fine.After everything happens here, I want to go to Abai and visit him, and secondly, I'll go and see the senior heroes of the Xieli Society." Yi Diandian said, "That's not necessary."
